sentences.text: Taemasosteus was a member of the class Placodermi, an extinct group of armored fish.
This species belongs to the parent group Arthrodira.
The family Taemasosteidae, which includes Taemasosteus, was later subsumed into the family Buchanosteidae.
It lived during the Emsian stage, between 410.62 and 393.47 million years ago.
